name: bug-fix
description: Clarify, implement, test, human review, summarize. Adapted from LoopForge's built-in bug-fix SOP (Tencent, MIT) for local in-process agents.

nodes.label: Clarify
nodes.prompt: Investigate the reported problem in this workspace: read the relevant code with your tools, then state in 5 bullets or fewer what is wrong, where (files and lines), and the smallest safe fix. Do not change any files in this step.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.prompt: Apply the smallest fix described by the Clarify step. Match the repo's existing style, change only what the fix needs, then run the project's checks yourself before finishing.

nodes.label: Human review
nodes.note: Read the Implement and Test outputs. Approve to continue, or send the work back to 'implement' with corrections.

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.prompt: Summarize this delivery in 5 bullets or fewer: what changed, what the checks proved, and anything left unverified.
